title: Cooperative UAV and Ground Station for Robust MEC of Dynamic Aquatic IoT: A Generative AI-Enhanced Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.24466v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The increasing aquatic Internet of Things (AIoTs) require computational support and coverage in applications such as maritime search and rescue. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can offer low-cost, flexible aerial services, and ground stations (GSs) can provide powerful supports, which can cooperate to help the AIoTs in complex scenarios. However, the collaboration between UAVs and GSs for AIoTs faces challenges of task uncertainties, AIoTs trajectory uncertainties, heterogeneities, and limited computational resources. To address these issues, we propose a cooperative UAV and GS based robust multi-access edge computing (MEC) framework to assist AIoTs in completing computational tasks. Specifically, we formulate the optimization problem of joint task offloading and UAV trajectory to minimize the total execution time, which is in the form of mixed integer nonlinear programming and NP-hard to tackle. translated_title: 面向动态水上物联网鲁棒移动边缘计算的无人机与地面站协同：一种生成式AI增强方法
translated_abstract: 日益增长的水上物联网在海上搜救等应用中需要计算支持和覆盖保障。无人机可以提供低成本、灵活的空中服务，地面站可以提供强大的支撑，二者可以协同帮助复杂场景中的水上物联网。然而，无人机与地面站为水上物联网提供服务的协作面临任务不确定性、水上物联网轨迹不确定性、异构性以及计算资源受限等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于无人机与地面站协同的鲁棒多接入边缘计算（MEC）框架，以辅助水上物联网完成计算任务。具体而言，我们将联合任务卸载与无人机轨迹优化问题建模为最小化总执行时间的优化问题，该问题属于混合整数非线性规划且为NP难问题。因此，我们提出了（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种生成式AI增强的无人机与地面站协同鲁棒边缘计算框架，通过联合任务卸载与无人机轨迹优化来最小化动态水上物联网计算任务的总执行时间。
